statement.zh-TW: 能分辨三張報表各自回答的問題：一段期間賺了多少、某一天擁有多少、現金怎麼進出
statement.en: Tell apart the question each statement answers: how much was earned over a period, what is owned on a given day, and how cash moved

text.zh-TW: 以為三張報表都在描述同一天的狀況
text.en: Thinking that all three statements describe the same day

text.zh-TW: 以為資產負債表會告訴你賺了多少
text.en: Thinking the balance sheet tells you how much was earned

text.zh-TW: 以為損益表的本期淨利就是帳上多出來的現金
text.en: Thinking that profit on the income statement is the extra cash in the account

statement.zh-TW: 能依一個實際情境問的是「一段期間」「某一天」還是「現金」，選出最該看的報表
statement.en: Given a real situation, choose the statement to look at depending on whether the question is about a period, a day or cash

text.zh-TW: 想知道付不付得出錢時去看損益表
text.en: Looking at the income statement to find out whether a bill can be paid

text.zh-TW: 想知道一段期間的表現時去看資產負債表
text.en: Looking at the balance sheet to judge performance over a period

statement.zh-TW: 能說明為什麼「賺到錢」與「收到現金」不一定同時發生，並指出賒銷與收款各動到哪些數字
statement.en: Explain why earning money and receiving cash do not always happen together, and say which figures a credit sale and a later collection each change

text.zh-TW: 以為收入要等收到錢才算
text.en: Thinking that revenue only counts once the cash is received

text.zh-TW: 把收回應收帳款當成一筆新的收入
text.en: Treating the collection of a receivable as new revenue

text.zh-TW: 以為賒銷在收到錢之前對報表沒有任何影響
text.en: Thinking a credit sale has no effect on the statements until cash arrives

statement.zh-TW: 能認出同一個數字在表與表之間怎麼連動：期末現金、本期淨利與資產負債表的關係
statement.en: Recognise how a figure links one statement to another: closing cash, profit for the period and the balance sheet

text.zh-TW: 以為三張報表各自獨立、數字互不相干
text.en: Thinking the three statements are independent and share no figures

text.zh-TW: 以為本期淨利結算後就消失，不會留在資產負債表上
text.en: Thinking profit disappears after the period ends and does not stay on the balance sheet

text.zh-TW: 把本期淨利當成資產負債表上同樣金額的現金
text.en: Treating profit for the period as the same amount of cash on the balance sheet
